info.name: RentCheck REST Account Settings Residents V3 API

params.name: filters[search]
params.description: Search value among tenant emails, first and last name, current and future lease property address.

params.name: filters[active]
params.description: When `true`, returns residents with a current and/or a future lease. When `false`, returns residents with a past lease or no lease information. HTTP query strings are always strings, so the value is compared against the literal `'true'` / `'false'`.

params.name: filters[deleted]
params.description:
When the literal string `'true'`, deleted residents are included. Any
other value (including `'false'`, missing, or anything else) is
treated as `false`. There is no explicit enum validation, so unknown
values are silently normalised to `false` rather than rejected as 400.

params.name: filters[emails]
params.description: Email(s) to filter residents by. Multiple values should be comma-separated.

params.name: filters[property_id]
params.description: Filters all residents for a specific property.

params.name: filters[occupancy_status][value]
params.description: Occupancy status(es) to filter residents by. Multiple values should be concatenated with a `|`. Allowed individual values are `future`, `past`, and `current`.

params.name: filters[occupancy_status][condition]
params.description: Condition to apply to the occupancy_status filter. The validator only accepts `any_of`. Note also that `filters[active]` and `filters[occupancy_status]` are mutually exclusive — supplying both is rejected by the request validator.

params.name: occupancy_status[]
params.description:
Legacy multi-value occupancy status filter, still accepted. Prefer
`filters[occupancy_status][value]`.

params.name: options[pagination][page_size]
params.description: How many items to be returned for each page.

params.name: options[sort][sort_type]
params.description:
Sort list in ascending or descending order. Accepted
case-insensitively.

params.name: options[sort][sort_by]
params.description: Sort list by a specific property.

items.docs:
Returns a paginated list of resident digests. V3 returns a trimmed `resident_v3_response_model`
projection (basic identity + `primary_occupancy`) and uses the `filters[...]` / `options[...]`
nested query-param syntax. Used internally by the web and mobile apps.
